description: Perform a native Yab action explicitly requested by the user: settings, spaces, tabs, page fonts or connecting Gmail. Read native_context and native_actions first. Give the exact target id/kind and schema arguments, expectedVersion from context where available, and a unique requestId for this effect. Reuse the same requestId on retries, never for another payload. needs_user means a confirmation in Yab; running means OAuth is still pending. Follow native_operation until verified; never claim completion beforehand. This does not grant Mac access or permission to change the agent's own rules.
name: native_apply
title: Change Yab
